title: One of Grusch's 40 witnesses died at a convenient time
summary: Jake Barber tells of One of Grusch's 40 witnesses died at a convenient time, about recent at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: one of them is the guy who's no longer with us. Um, whose demise was was quite conveniently timed for those who might have something to do with it.

plain: Jake Barber, a man who says he flew a helicopter to recover a UFO, talks about the roughly 40 witnesses that whistleblower David Grusch, a former intelligence officer, says backed his claims. Barber says one of those witnesses has since died, and that the death came at a very convenient time for whoever might want him silenced. He tells it to suggest that the people involved face real danger.
